title: fix(tools): raise ToolError when OpenAPITool gets a non-2xx response

files.patch:
@@ -374,6 +374,12 @@ async def _run(
                 )
                 output = OpenAPIToolOutput(response.status_code, response.text)
                 await self.emitter.emit("after_fetch", AfterFetchEvent(url=str(url), data=output))
+                if not response.is_success:
+                    # The operation path, not the resolved URL, so a credential in the server URL is not echoed
+                    message = f"{method.upper()} {raw_path} failed with HTTP {response.status_code}"
+                    if response.text:
+                        message += f": {response.text[:500]}"
+                    raise ToolError(message)
                 return output
         except httpx.HTTPError as err:
             raise ToolError(f"Request to {url} has failed.", cause=err)

+@pytest.mark.unit
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", [302, 404, 500])
+async def test_non_success_status_raises_tool_error(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, status: int) -> None:
+    async def fake_request(self: httpx.AsyncClient, method: str, url: str, **kwargs: object) -> httpx.Response:
+        return httpx.Response(status, text='{"error": "nope"}')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(httpx.AsyncClient, "request", fake_request)
+
+    [tool] = OpenAPITool.from_schema(_schema("https://example.invalid", "/pets", {}))
+
+    with pytest.raises(ToolError, match=str(status)):
+        await tool.run({})
+
+
+@pytest.mark.unit
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_non_success_error_truncates_long_body(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    async def fake_request(self: httpx.AsyncClient, method: str, url: str, **kwargs: object) -> httpx.Response:
+        return httpx.Response(502, text="<html>" + "x" * 5000)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(httpx.AsyncClient, "request", fake_request)
+
+    [tool] = OpenAPITool.from_schema(_schema("https://example.invalid", "/pets", {}))
+
+    with pytest.raises(ToolError) as exc_info:
+        await tool.run({})
+
+    message = str(exc_info.value)
+    assert "502" in message
+    assert "<html>xxx" in message
+    assert "x" * 600 not in message
